ld.title: Senior Statistical Programmer
ld.desc:
Overview
Work as a senior programmer on clinical and non-clinical trials; producing complex datasets and outputs to excellent quality whilst adhering to deliverable timelines. Good knowledge of CDISC SDTM and ADaM implementation guidelines; producing, reviewing and updating complex data specifications; creating and debugging complex macros; understanding Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) and output shells for day to day programming activities. Excellent team work ethos, willingness to help others and learn new skills from working in a team environment.
This role is full-time and fully-remote. The successful candidate may be based in India.
Responsibilities
The following areas of expertise will be aligned to the role...
Statistical expertise and scientific leadership
Leadership and people development
Compliance, quality and governance
Communication and influence
Qualifications
BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related discipline.
Strong experience in clinical trial statistics and SAS programming, supporting Phase II/III studies across analysis, reporting, and regulatory submission activities.
Hands-on expertise in SDTM, ADaM, TLF development and validation, with strong knowledge of CDISC standards and submission-ready deliverables. 
Experience supporting regulatory submissions, including NDA/BLA, MAA, ISS/ISE, eCTD packages, define.xml, reviewers’ guides, and responding to regulatory authority queries.
Ability to interpret protocols, SAPs, shells, and statistical specifications, translate requirements into high-quality analysis outputs, and identify issues proactively.
Strong understanding of submission QC, traceability, data integrity, and programming best practices, including independent validation, macro usage, documentation, and adherence to SOPs.
Proven ability to work independently with statisticians, programmers, data management, medical writing, and sponsor teams, manage timelines, communicate risks early, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight submission deadlines.
MSc in Mathematics, Computer Science or a related discipline is advantageous.
Why Join Us?
Remote working and flexible working hours
Career development, mentorship, and continuous learning
Supportive, friendly, and collaborative culture 
About Phastar
Phastar is an award-winning biometrics and data science CRO, trusted by pharma, biotech, and medical device companies worldwide. With a global team of data specialists, we bring expertise, precision, and pace to every trial, because behind every data point is a patient waiting for treatment.
We transform complex data into clear, actionable intelligence, helping accelerate drug development, and bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.
Awards & Recognition
SCRIP – Best Contract Research Organization, Specialist Provider
Citeline – 2025 Award Winner
Fierce CRO Awards – Recognized Industry Leader 
Apply Now
Be part of a team known for technical expertise, quality, and impact. We value Excellence, Collaboration, Integrity, Innovation, and Passion—and we seek team members who embody these qualities. Apply today!
Phastar is committed to the principles and practices of equal opportunities and to encourage the establishment of a diverse workforce. It is our policy to employ individuals on the basis of their suitability for the work to be performed and their potential for development, regardless of age, sex, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion, or belief. This includes creating a culture that fully reflects our commitment to equal opportunities for all.

ld.desc:
Overview

Producing, reviewing and updating eCRF specifications and sections of the Data Handling Manual. Excellent team work ethos, able to manage workload of others, willingness to help others, share skills in a team environment and contribute to process improvement and company profile.

ld.desc:

Creation of advanced custom programs as per Data Review Convention specifications as required. Program reports and listings which contribute to the standardization of process and reports used for data review and analysis for external partners/vendors. Develop and maintain CDASH compliant therapeutic area and global eCRF libraries ensuring efficient mapping to current SDTM standards. Good knowledge of CDISC CDASH and SDTM implementation guidelines. Participate in study specific eCRF programming strategy meeting at study set up.

Create/Program edit checks, special action and derivations as per the Data Review Convention specifications.
Ensure non -eCRF technologies for data capture (e.g., ePRO, coding, IWRS/RTSM) are deployed as per requirements, including integrations with other systems, platforms or reporting environments with timelines for consumable data outlined.

University or college degree in Life Sciences, Mathematics, Computer Science or equivalent degree

ld.title: Senior Product Manager - Mitigation Platform
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
Job Description
About the Team: Mitigation Platform 
The Mitigation Platform at Wise is dedicated to enhancing the scalability, efficiency, and quality of Wise Operations. Our mission is to:
Develop a robust framework for generating and distributing work across all operations, ensuring tasks are assigned to the right person at the right time.
Create tools and frameworks that empower teams to design their specific workflows, accelerating time to market and offering customizable complexity.
Establish a comprehensive reference for a 360-degree view of customer data, enabling our operations to swiftly identify and address issues.
Our squad consists of approximately 30 skilled professionals, organized into three cross-functional teams, all focused on reducing handling time, increasing automation, and minimizing friction through innovative technology.
About the Role:
As the Senior Product Manager in Mitigation Platform, you will lead a dynamic, cross-functional team dedicated to standardizing and elevating our operational workflows. Your goal is to equip Wise’s operational teams with out-of-the-box solutions and actionable data insights so they can serve our customers efficiently and consistently. You will own the solutions for case and document request lifecycle management, customer communication tools, and the agent-facing platforms needed to swiftly resolve customer-impacting issues.
Key Responsibilities:
Spearhead Servicing improvements by setting the product direction and aligning engineering, design, and operations within Mitigation Platform.
Provide strategic direction while being hands-on in project leadership and execution. Own the product roadmap and define KPIs/OKRs for your team.
Collaborate closely with Design, Analytics, Data Science, Operations, and Compliance teams to integrate improvements across the product lifecycle.
Oversee the execution of key projects, including decreasing friction for customers, automating reviews and assisting agents making the right decisions in reviews.
This role will give you the opportunity to:
Build world-class products with a world class product and engineering team: The role is a unique opportunity to build innovative, state-of-the-art solutions. It’s also an opportunity to work with some of the smartest product thinkers in the world.
Make a real impact on people's lives - by building world-class products you will be able to make a change for millions of people and how they relate to international transfers - how they pay, hold and receive funds internationally - helping people to make the best use of their money across the Globe. Directly impacting Wise's mission zero by reducing the cost of servicing, opening a way to decrease our prices.
Empower people to make decisions - we want people closest to the problems to drive solutions. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls.
Grow as a leader - You will build and inspire your own team, but also other teams to contribute to our mission.
Being a key connection between global and regional product teams and operational teams. Interacting with almost all product teams at Wise, gaining a deep understanding of all of our products.
A couple of skills that might describe you as a PM:
You have proven experience in building products at scale – You’ve worked on a product with thousands or even millions of customers. You’re able to navigate the product and organisational complexity of a product at scale.
You have leadership experience – You’ve led product teams before, and have experience hiring and growing the team.
You’re hands on – You thrive as a player-coach. You are able to operate at many levels of detail, flipping between executing as an individual contributor and leading a wider team. You have a superpower as an individual contributor, whether it’s going deep on data analysis, design, regulations or engineering.
You’re data-driven – You are able to self-serve with data, and use it to both identify opportunities and measure your impact. You can get the entire company behind you by telling stories with data.
You’re an AI-augmented PM – You don’t just build products; you know how to use AI to build them faster. You actively leverage LLMs and AI tools to synthesize vast amounts of user research, summarize complex regulatory documents, write SQL queries to self-serve data, and rapidly prototype ideas. You use AI to move faster and smarter without waiting on engineering.
You have fresh ideas - You don’t accept the status quo, but are interested in solving problems in novel ways. You are able to communicate the impact of those ideas and formulate plans to implement them
Additional Information
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Description
Role & Job purpose
As a FinCrime Operations Team Lead - Sanctions you will develop and oversee the daily operations of a team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists. Your primary purpose is to ensure the effective mitigation of financial crime risks associated with Wise's customers, while maintaining a strong focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and a customer-centric approach.
You will foster a high-performing team, drive operational excellence, and act as a subject matter expert in KYC/AML/Fraud/Screening and financial crime prevention. You will be responsible for ensuring your team meets performance targets, maintains or elevates quality standards, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement within the FinCrime Operations organization.
The FinCrime Operations Team Lead is a dual-focused leader, combining strong people leadership with domain and operational expertise. You will be instrumental in building and refining processes that prioritise customer impact while maintaining focus on the evolving risks within the financial services industry, specific product vulnerabilities, and the requirements set by regulations and partners. This includes supporting the development of compliant and scalable processes and possessing an understanding of financial
crime risks associated with our customers, products, and tooling.
Job Responsibilities
Team Leadership
You will lead by example, driving a customer-focused mindset across your team and the wider fincrime organization. You are instrumental in fostering a high-performance, results-driven culture defined by strong ownership and accountability. This involves building and nurturing high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adaptability in our change-oriented environment. Fincrime Operations Team Lead demonstrates strong capabilities in timely conflict resolution and fosters open communication and guides effective mediation to ensure a positive working environment. You should be visible and actively engaged in team management. Your focus is on unifying the team behind shared goals (and wider FinCrime/servicing
strategies) and driving collective actions.
People management
Coach and develop a strong team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists with varying levels of experience, providing tailored guidance, and taking swift, decisive action to manage performance issues effectively, ensuring sustained excellence and growth. Provide regular, constructive, and actionable feedback to your direct reports. Coach and mentor team members to support their growth, develop their skills, and help them reach their full potential. Design and manage performance or development plans in identified areas. Conduct career map check-ins and make recommendations for demotions, promotions, salary raises, and other role related decisions.
Operational management
You will oversee the daily operations of the team, ensuring adherence to relevant regulations and internal policies and processes.
Identify and propose opportunities for process and tooling improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency or to ensure effective cross-team collaboration on joint initiatives.
Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations. Be on top of timely admin related tasks including but not limited to scheduling, training, hiring, interviewing, organising team activities, and others.
Performance management
Measure team and individual KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are consistently met while maintaining focus on customer experience and adherence to internal guidelines. Drive high-quality results for both the team and individuals, continuously enhancing overall quality outcomes. Conduct timely quality reviews, ensuring high decision accuracy and effectively communicate the importance of quality assurance.
Conduct regular and impactful one on one coaching sessions (usually on a weekly or biweekly basis), provide clear and actionable feedback. Ensure tasks are managed timely and aligned with the team’s goals. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best
practices and enhance overall team spirit. Addresses underperformance promptly through coaching and setting SMART goals, and ensures all interventions are well-documented. Understand and be able to articulate how to move key metrics at team and individual level through efficient performance and task management.
Expertise sharing
Be a subject matter expert in financial crime areas with the ability to obtain and maintain sufficient subject matter expertise required to train, develop and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, domain-specific processes and best practices. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Perform and support deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership. Assist senior leadership with reviews and developing our processes, task management and in other operational areas as requested to ensure compliant and effective servicing function
Issue Management and Escalation
Escalate tooling or processing incidents, high-risk customer issues, control weaknesses, or other material problems to direct
leadership in a timely and informative manner, following established protocols.
Planning and execution

Possess strong knowledge of team processes and tooling, leveraging data to support initiative execution. This involves taking full ownership of your team's results, setting targets for improvement, and providing insights to stakeholders. Set and progress towards goals, adeptly identifying and resolving blockers or issues, whether performance or metric-related, to optimize output and results.

Collaborate closely with stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders on varied operational or domain related topics. Proactively work on improving cross-team communication and collaboration, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team. Employ impactful and inspiring
communication skills, unifying individuals behind shared goals, and leverage strong presentation skills to convey vision and progress.

Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, trainings, workshops, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

reports, summaries, and customer communications. Additional languages are a plus.

ld.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
Job Description
We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our growing team in Austin, Texas. 
The Wise Platform team works with financial institutions and major tech companies at a global level to offer Wise products and services directly to their customers through our API.
Solutions Engineers make it happen by working with partners to build integrations to our class-leading international finance products, while improving Wise Platform by increasing the capabilities of our public API. The team’s goals are to drive the growth of Wise through partnerships and integrations by creating a world class product set delivered through third parties.
As part of this role, you will
Provide technical consulting and product guidance to banks and other partners integrating Wise, primarily post-sale
Ensure partners deliver the best integration within their constraints for an excellent customer experience
Assist partners in the implementation phase, defining technical solutions and documenting requirements
Support business development by aiding larger partners requiring novel features, including technical scoping and feature design.
Participate in feature definition, prioritisation, and long-term strategy planning with the Wise Platform team
Collaborate with Implementation Managers, Product Managers, and Engineers, making product and project decisions
Design and develop new features for Wise services and expose them on the public API when needed
Work on scaling Wise Platform into new regions, overcoming associated challenges
Improve integration experience through documentation, APIs, SDKs, code samples, and reference implementations
Collaborate with the technical presales team to support the sales cycle and secure new partnerships
Enhance internal processes to handle multiple integrations in parallel
Troubleshoot, test, and resolve technical issues, aiding the API support team with complex problems
This role will give you the opportunity to
Choose your own path to success - you’ll have the freedom to define the vision and responsibility for making it happen
Identify problems and unlock opportunities for Wise and partners through technology solutions
Inspire other teams internally and externally with your ideas, knowledge and self-starter attitude
Travel to work with our teams in Tallinn, London, and New York, as well as visit our partners across North America
Qualifications
Strong problem-solving and organisational skills, able to handle ambiguity and competing priorities.
Familiarity with common design patterns and architectural principles, including domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven architecture (EDA), and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with  Java (Spring), Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh architectures and technologies such as RESTful APIs, API design, Swagger, OpenAPI, and OAuth2.
Familiarity and working experience with  relational databases (e.g.MySQL, PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
At least 6+ years in customer-facing engineering roles ideally within financial services or similar domain (e.g. solutions engineer, IT consultant, partner engineer, integration engineer, solutions consultant).
Clear communication and strong interpersonal skills. 
Customer centric approach.
Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver projects. 
Strong self-management skills are essential, including the ability to manage individual projects and deals effectively.  Prioritizing tasks across various work streams is also a key requirement.
Even if you don't have every single skill listed, we still want you to apply!
Additional Information
This is a hybrid position located in Austin, Texas, and not fully remote (minimum 3 days at office).

ld.title: Software Engineer - Database Platform
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
Job Description
About the role
We’re looking for a Senior Platform Engineer (IC2 level) to join our Database Platform team. You’ll help build and operate a global platform that’s scalable, reliable, and secure - developing the internal database platform, automation, and tooling that powers hundreds of databases across multiple environments. You’ll work on high-scale systems used by hundreds of engineers, shaping how we run databases globally.
How we work:
We believe in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. You’ll think holistically about the ecosystem, while also delivering real solutions - collaborating across the Platform tribe to make our systems more resilient and developer-friendly. At this, you help set and evolve technical standards, design patterns, and best practices for the platform.
As we scale, we need engineers who can simplify complex infrastructure, build guardrails, and deliver platforms that help product teams move fast - without compromising reliability or security. You proactively identify technical debt and plan remediation work to keep risk within appetite.
You’ll work closely with other Platform and Data teams to ensure best practices are followed and the right abstractions are in place. You provide strong technical input into product and platform roadmaps, explaining why work is prioritised and what impact it delivers.
You’ll be part of a team that empowers hundreds of developers to build reliable services faster, with modern tooling and infrastructure at scale. The systems you design will directly impact the availability, performance, and safety of our customers’ data worldwide. You’ll join a collaborative team that values technical excellence, learning, and continuous improvement.
At this, you are a recognised technical leader, shaping both the platform’s direction and the engineers around you
What will you be working on?:
Design, build, and evolve our internal cloud-based database platform.
Lead these initiatives end-to-end, optimising for predictable delivery and measurable outcomes.
Define the long-term automation strategy, including migrations, upgrades, and failure recovery patterns.
Help embed security and compliance controls (encryption, auth, RBAC, network controls) into Yugabyte platform components.
Be accountable for the availability, reliability, and security of the systems you own.
Collaborate with product teams, SREs and DBAs to apply platform guardrails for services adopting database technologies.
Act as the escalation point for your area, leading minor and major incident resolution and post-incident reviews.
Mentor and coach other engineers, support onboarding, and actively reduce single points of failure.
Participate in on-call rotations and provide senior escalation support when required.
Represent the team in cross-tribe or cross-company engineering efforts and guilds.
Participate in interviewing and hiring activities, following best practices and helping maintain a high engineering bar.
What do you need?:
Essential
Significant Platform Engineering experience, with demonstrated senior ownership of production platform systems at scale.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).
Strong Python development skills (or similar).
Solid understanding of software engineering principles - writing secure, testable, maintainable code.
Proficiency with Cloud APIs and DevOps tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, Teleport).
Clear communicator who collaborates well across teams.
Ability to clearly articulate technical trade-offs, business impact, and customer value.
Experience leading or significantly contributing to incident response and post-incident improvement.
Highly sought
Practical experience with distributed databases at scale (YugabyteDB preferred, or CockroachDB/TiDB/Cloud Spanner).
Deep operational expertise with distributed SQL systems in production.
Experience or strong interest in implementing migration patterns (CDC/logical replication, verification and rollback) and automation for provisioning, backups and upgrades.
Demonstrated leadership of migration strategy and execution.
Experience building Database-as-a-Service platforms or internal developer tooling.
Experience influencing technical or product roadmaps.

ld.title: Director of Business Operations - North America
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
Job Description
We’re looking for a Director of Business Operations (NorthAm) to join us and do things differently.
This is a critical leadership position designed for a strategic and hands-on leader who will shape the future of our operations across North America. You will not only lead business operations for the region but also proactively identify opportunities for improvement and guide a team of BizOps managers to execute these initiatives.
This is a high-visibility leadership role with significant regional scope. For the right candidate, this position offers a clear succession pathway to senior executive entity leadership in North America. You will serve as the primary operational representative to our regulators and the regional Board of Directors.
What you’ll do.
You will lead the North American operational strategy, directing a matrixed footprint of over 1,000 support and servicing team members located in our European hubs (Budapest and Tallinn), while building out our local teams in Austin and São Paulo.
Strategic Leadership: Lead the business operations organization in the region, identifying and capitalizing on opportunities to enhance efficiency and performance. You will work closely with global heads to shape the future of the region, including location strategy and capacity planning.
Team Leadership: Lead and develop a small team of high-performing BizOps managers, guiding them to execute on key operational improvements.
Regulatory & Board Representation: Represent our operations confidently and credibly in front of regulators and our board of directors.
Expansion and Growth: Collaborate with the North American leadership team on strategic expansion into new markets and regions.
Talent Development: Grow and mentor local operational leaders, hire new talent, and establish effective local ways of working, including hybrid models and career growth opportunities.
Execution in a Flat Structure: Embrace our flat organizational structure by being a leader who can both strategize and execute, getting your hands dirty to solve problems and drive projects forward.
Accountability & Success Metrics.
Your success will be measured by your ability to scale our regional operations efficiently and sustainably. 
While you will ultimately hold accountability for regional servicing metrics (including SLAs, efficiency targets and resolution quality), your primary focus will be on driving structural improvements. You will work in lockstep with our product teams to build forward-looking infrastructure that upgrades our operations.
Operational Excellence: Proactively identify systemic operational vulnerabilities, lead high-impact automation projects, and drive contact deflection strategies to scale our volume without linearly scaling headcount.
Strategic Planning: Translate product requirements into a sustainable servicing model and formulate both long-term strategies and actionable 6-month plans.
Data-Driven Decisions: Build, track and execute against robust KPIs, using data to uncover operational insights and eliminate customer friction points.
Location and Talent Strategy: Act as a "local office leader", owning decisions on location changes, and contributing to our hybrid work strategy. You will also provide key input into forecasting and hiring decisions.
Qualifications
We are looking for a seasoned leader with a proven ability to operate at a senior level in a dynamic, product-driven environment.
Essential:

ld.title: KYC Operations Senior Analyst - Deactivations
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Job Description
As a Senior Analyst in KYC Operations in our newly established Deactivations Team, you will play a crucial role in strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting the integrity of our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and to grasp the risks linked to Wise customers. You will thoroughly investigate complex KYC cases, equipped with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant, and accurate. This isn't just following a new process; it's about delivering justice and upholding our integrity when it matters the most. This role is a great opportunity for people who are interested in deepening their knowledge in the KYC domain. 
As a KYC Operations Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting a financial crime program that is driven by Wise's mission for money without borders, transparency, and protecting customers. We are looking for someone with experience in enhanced due diligence, an excitement and desire to learn and grow with this new team, and strong organisational and communication skills.
Responsibilities
Conduct Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews based on customer’s risk profile. Take frequent risk based approach decisions while conducting customer reviews ensuring risk management standards are met.
Review customer transaction history and provide insights into customer behaviour patterns that may indicate risks. Conduct periodic reviews and analyse changes in customers history and account usage.
Review and assess high risk customer reports to provide analysis and approval as per the set policies and procedures.
Exercise discretion in setting priorities, identifying customer records that require further review and taking action to obtain and follow-up on the information and/or documentation requested.
Ensure that information and documentation provided by customers meet our risk appetite for onboarding and maintaining high risk customers.
Conduct in depth analysis, using provided documentation or external sources (e.g. websites and company registries) ensuring that only customers within risk appetite are onboarded. Perform searches utilising internet sources and/or third-party vendors to obtain information on prospects and new/existing customers.
Communicate with other internal teams when required to handle escalated or complicated cases.
Provide guidance and responses to daily inquiries from peers, front-line and management regarding complex matters and case analysis, when appropriate.
Maintain a high understanding of AML/CFT Regulations and how these impact the business, as well as Wise products and services.
When warranted, be capable of drafting SAR narratives to report activity deemed unusual.
Taking part in and leading projects related to Deactivations Team processes and guidelines. Assist in identifying improvement opportunities and contribute to policy updates, training materials, and standard operating procedures.
Draft reports to internal and external stakeholders, periodically and when requested.
Support Wise in internal and external audits and regulatory process related queries reviews.
Effective communication with customers by the relevant communication channels that the team operates with.
Perform your tasks and responsibilities within the expected key performance indicators set by the leadership team.
Qualifications
Excellent verbal and written English skills (additional language skills are a plus) with the ability to clearly articulate your thoughts.
A minimum of 3+ years of experience in Operations or financial services, (preferably in CDD/EDD/AML or compliance roles). 
Working knowledge of global KYC/AML compliance regulations and standards.

Familiarity reading legal and regulatory documents.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related field
Certifications: ICA, CAMS, or equivalent certification (EDD/AML focused)

The Finance team is critical in supporting the Wise mission. We are now listed in the US stock exchange in 2026 and need to ensure our technical accounting team is set-up to meet the respective regulatory requirements.
We’re looking for a HEAD OF TECHNICAL ACCOUNTING to join us

ld.title: Consultant - Ear, Nose & Throat (ENT)
ld.desc:
The Consultant in ENT (Otolaryngology) is responsible for providing high-quality, specialized ear, nose, and throat care within both physical clinic and digital care settings. The role focuses on the comprehensive assessment, accurate diagnosis, treatment planning, and follow-up management of acute and chronic ENT conditions through evidence-based clinical practice. The Consultant ENT ensures patient-centred care, clinical excellence, and patient safety while contributing to quality improvement and the strategic development of ENT services across virtual and in-person care delivery at Bupa CareConnect. 
Specialized Assessment and Diagnosis 
•        Conduct comprehensive ENT assessments through in-person and virtual consultation settings 
•        Diagnose acute and chronic ENT conditions using evidence-based clinical approaches and investigations 
•        Interpret imaging, laboratory results, and audiological or vestibular test findings 
•        Recommend and coordinate appropriate referrals and advanced investigations when required 
•        Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation in the EMR system 
Management and Treatment Planning 
•        Develop individualized, evidence-based treatment and follow-up plans for ENT patients 
•        Provide medical and procedural management for a wide range of ENT conditions 
•        Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans as clinical needs evolve 
•        Educate patients regarding their conditions, preventive care, and treatment adherence expectations 
•        Coordinate continuity of care across physical and digital care settings 
Clinical Quality and Safe Practice 
•        Ensure compliance with clinical governance requirements, telemedicine regulations, and patient safety standards 
•        Adhere to institutional protocols and international ENT clinical guidelines 
•        Participate in quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and peer review processes 
•        Report, analyze, and manage clinical incidents and adverse events appropriately 
•        Support compliance with CBAHI, JCI, SCFHS, and applicable accreditation standards 
Multidisciplinary Collaboration 
•        Collaborate with multidisciplinary healthcare teams including internal medicine, radiology, and allied health 
•        Coordinate referrals and continuity of patient care with internal and external specialists 
•        Participate in MDT case discussions and clinical meetings 
•        Provide specialist support, second opinions, and clinical guidance to other healthcare providers 
Patient Experience and Satisfaction 
•        Deliver compassionate, patient-centered ENT care with clarity and empathy 
•        Address patient concerns promptly and ensure clear communication about diagnoses and management options 
•        Promote patient education and engagement in their own care and preventive health 
•        Support organizational initiatives aimed at improving patient experience and Net Promoter Scores (NPS) 
Professional Development and Leadership 
•        Maintain active SCFHS licensure and comply with all CME requirements 
•        Stay updated with advancements in ENT clinical practice, surgical techniques, and healthcare technologies 
•        Mentor junior physicians and support the professional development of the medical team 
•        Contribute to organizational strategic and operational goals of the ENT service

ld.title: Manager - FWA Data Science
ld.desc:
Role Purpose: 
FWA Data Science is responsible for transforming validated FWA analytical prototypes into robust, scalable, and measurable detection models ready for production implementation. The role owns model enhancement, feature engineering, calibration, validation, explainability, performance assessment, and continuous model improvement throughout the solution lifecycle. 
Working closely with Actuarial, Claims Integrity, and FWA AI Engineering, the role ensures FWA detection models remain effective, relevant, and aligned with evolving fraud patterns after deployment. 
Key Accountabilities: 
1- Model Industrialization Readiness; 
Assess AI/ML prototypes received from Actuarial teams. 
Refine model logic and improve statistical rigor. 
Enhance feature engineering methodologies. 
Validate and clarify prototype assumptions. 
Develop explainable detection methodologies. 
Support migration of approved analytical models into cloud-based solutions. 
2- Detection Model Development & Enhancement; 
Improve and retrain FWA models using new data and investigation outcomes. 
Develop advanced fraud detection features. 
Enhance anomaly detection models. 
Build risk scoring methodologies. 
Improve model precision and operational effectiveness. 
3- Model Validation & Performance Science; 
Define model success metrics. 
monitor precision, recall, and business impact. 
Perform false-positive and false-negative analysis after go-live 
Validate model outputs with investigators. 
Support production readiness reviews. 
4- Fraud Intelligence & Pattern Evolution; 
Analyze investigation outcomes. 
Identify emerging fraud behaviors. 
Design new detection features. 
Recommend modifications to existing models. 
Collaborate with FWA operations on evolving threats. 
5- Continuous Model Optimization; 
Monitor business effectiveness of deployed models. 
Recommend retraining and recalibration activities. 
Support periodic model reviews. 
Maintain model documentation and governance artifacts.

ld.title: Manager - FWA AI Engineer

The role translates approved business requirements and data science models into scalable production solutions, integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while ensuring reliability, performance, and business value. Working closely with the FWA Lead, FWA Data Scientist, investigators, and business stakeholders, the role drives the successful implementation and continuous enhancement of FWA AI use cases. 
Key Accountabilities: 
1- FWA Solution Design & Feasibility Assessment; 
Assess technical feasibility of approved FWA use cases. 
Evaluate data availability, technical requirements, and implementation complexity. 
Define solution approaches for AI-driven FWA detection. 
Develop technical requirements and implementation plans. 
Recommend optimal AI techniques and technologies for delivery. 
2- AI Solution Development & Engineering; 
Build and optimize AI solutions supporting FWA detection and investigation activities. 
Translate models and analytical logic into scalable cloud-native solutions on GCP. 
Implement machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics, and document intelligence solutions. 
Develop APIs, scoring services, and integration components required for operational deployment. 
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with technical standards. 
Collaborate with the FWA Data Scientist to operationalize validated models. 
3- Production Deployment & Integration; 
Deploy AI solutions into operational environments. 
Integrate AI outputs with internal systems and workflows. 
Coordinate with Data Engineering and TIDES (IT) teams to enable production deployment. 
Support release planning and deployment activities. 
Ensure successful transition from development to production. 
4- Testing & Quality Assurance; 
Conduct technical testing of AI solutions. 
Support user acceptance testing with business stakeholders. 
Validate output accuracy, reliability, and performance. 
Identify and resolve implementation issues. 
Ensure solutions meet defined business and technical requirements. 
5- Solution Maintenance & Continuous Improvement; 
Support ongoing enhancement of deployed FWA AI solutions. 
Implement model improvements identified by the Data Science team. 
Address technical issues and optimize solution performance. 
Incorporate new fraud detection capabilities and business requirements. 
Maintain technical documentation and solution knowledge assets.

The role ensures total compliance with Saudi Arabian standards (MOH, CBAHI, CHI, Civil Defence, municipalities, etc.) and utilizes relevant portals to maintain the legal and operational readiness of the organization.

1-Facility Non-Medical Licensing: 
Manage and renew Commercial Registrations (CR) municipal permits, civil defence licenses, and other licenses. That includes gathering requirements from different internal and external stakeholders. 
Oversee government portals requirements and monitor licenses validity and expiry dates. 
2-Facility Medical Licensing & Accreditation: 
Execute medical facility licensing and renewals through the Seha (MOH) and CHI portals. 
Lead the administrative preparation for CBAHI accreditation and periodic inspections. 
Ensure the facility’s scope of services aligns with its official MOH medical license.

Monitor changes in Saudi Labor Law, MOH and relevant regulations to advise management on risks. 
Streamline the digital archiving of all licenses for easy internal access.

ld.title: Technician - Audiology
ld.desc:
The Audiology Technician plays a vital role in supporting audiologists and other healthcare professionals in the assessment, diagnosis, and management of patients with hearing and balance disorders. This position requires specialized knowledge of audiology procedures, technical competence, strong communication skills, and a patient-centred approach to care. 
Patient Care: 
    Conduct and assist with audiological diagnostic procedures such as pure-tone audiometry, tympanometry, otoacoustic emissions (OAE), hearing screenings, speech audiometry, and other audiological assessments according to established protocols. 
    Prepare patients for hearing assessments, explain testing procedures, and ensure patient comfort and cooperation. 
   Assist audiologists during specialized assessments and hearing aid evaluations. 
   Ensure proper patient positioning and testing environment. 
Patient Education and Support: 
Assess patient educational needs and coordinate with relevant departments as needed. 
Educate patients and families regarding hearing disorders, diagnostic procedures, hearing conservation, hearing aids, and treatment plans as directed by the audiologist. 
Provide emotional support and reassurance throughout the patient journey. 
Ensure patients understand follow-up instructions and recommendations 
Collaboration and Communication: 
Collaborate closely with physicians, nurses, speech therapists, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate patient care. 
Maintain effective communication with team members regarding patient status, test results, and service requirements. 
Facilitate smooth patient flow and continuity of care. 
Documentation and Record Keeping: 
Accurately document audiological test results, patient information, interventions, and observations within Electronic Medical Records (EMR). 
Maintain complete and accurate audiology records. 
Ensure compliance with documentation standards, legal requirements, and departmental policies. 
Maintain patient confidentiality at all times. 
Safety and Infection Control Quality Improvement and Compliance: 
 Ensure audiology equipment is cleaned, calibrated, maintained, and ready for use according to manufacturer recommendations and departmental standards. 
 Adhere to infection prevention and control standards. 
Identify and report equipment malfunctions, safety concerns, and environmental hazards 
Comply with organizational policies, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements. 
Participate in quality improvement initiatives and patient safety programs 
Assist supervisors with additional work-related responsibilities within scope of practice.  
Professional Development: 
Stay current with advances in audiology technology, hearing assessment techniques, hearing devices, and patient care practices.

Job Description
We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.
Your mission
Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.
Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across 6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.
As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.
You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.
How you'll contribute to our mission
New product reviews, onboarding and approval
- Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.
- Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.
- Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.
New entity launches
- Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.
- Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.
- Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.
Execution and implementation
- Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.
- Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.
Support
- Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.
- Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.
Qualifications
 A bit about you
- You know regulated finance. You have experience in implementation, controls, regulatory operations or treasury operations in financial services or fintech, and you're used to working alongside Compliance to launch things the right way.
- You understand how customer money is protected. You know safeguarding, client money/CASS or a similar framework for protecting customer funds. If you know one regime well and are keen to learn others, that works too.
- You enjoy getting deep into the processing logic. You're comfortable with reconciliations, ledgers and financial data. You like to understand in depth how money flows through a product and what it depends on, and you can explain what a reconciliation break means and why it matters.
- You create clarity. You bring people together behind a common goal, balance different points of view and bring structure to complex problems. You write clearly, and you can explain complex concepts in simple terms to engineers, compliance specialists, finance teams and senior stakeholders without losing the nuance.
- You get it done. You keep many workstreams moving across teams and time zones without losing track of the details. You hold others to account without being their line manager, and you follow things through to the end.
- You stay calm when things go wrong. You make sound calls during incidents, and you know when to escalate.

- Experience with control frameworks, obligation-to-control mapping or risk tools.
- Working knowledge of SQL or data tools (e.g. Looker, Snowflake) for investigating issues yourself.
- Experience launching a new regulated entity or a new market.
- Familiarity with safeguarding rules in more than one region (UK, EU, APAC, North America).

We’re looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager [AL2] to lead analytics for our Online Platforms vertical. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role in a fast-scaling “start-up within a scale-up” environment. You’ll turn ambiguous problems into structured analysis, insights into compelling narratives and opportunities into high-conviction product bets.
The role will require you to be hands-on and develop a deep understanding of our products, partners and opportunity areas. You’ll also build the analytics foundations needed to scale, including reliable data models, clear metric definitions and effective self-serve reporting.

You’ll coach analysts to partner closely with teams on day-to-day product questions, while staying hands-on with the most complex and consequential opportunities yourself.
You’ll help us answer questions such as:
Where are the biggest opportunities to grow money transfers around the world?
What matters most to customers when they decide where, when and how to send money?
How do price, speed and convenience shape customers’ choices and behaviour?
How could an AI-powered concierge help customers find and complete the right transfer, while making the experience simpler and more personal?
How can we make the experience work better for both new and returning customers?
Which customer problems should we solve to make the biggest difference to growth and customer value?
How should we focus our product strategy to grow our money transfer revenues 10x over the next few years?

Lead discovery and opportunity finding. Explore customer behaviour and the end-to-end transfer journey to identify unmet needs, friction and growth opportunities. Help the squad understand not just what is happening, but where it has the greatest opportunity to act.
Influence the whole customer decision. Bring an analytical perspective to how customers weigh price, speed and convenience when choosing how to send money, across both new and returning customer journeys.
Turn opportunities into product priorities. Size customer and commercial opportunities, develop clear points of view and help teams make focused, evidence-based choices about what to build and why.
Lead and develop a group of senior analysts. Set a high bar for analytical thinking and impact, coach analysts in their work and careers, and create the conditions for them to support their teams effectively.
Enable strong day-to-day squad decisions. Coach analysts to work closely with their product teams, bring useful insights into planning and discovery, and help teams learn from product changes and customer behaviour.
Stay hands-on with the most important problems. Work directly on high-impact or ambiguous questions, and guide the team through complex analysis when the strategic stakes are high.
Bring people together around a shared view. Communicate complex evidence clearly, influence senior stakeholders and help cross-functional teams turn strategic choices into action.
Qualifications
What you’ll bring
Experience leading and developing strong analytics teams, including experienced or senior analysts.
A track record of shaping product strategy and business direction through analytics.
Strong product and commercial judgement: you can connect customer needs, product choices, growth and sustainable economics.
Experience leading discovery and identifying high-value opportunities in ambiguous problem spaces.
A deep understanding of product analytics and customer behaviour across acquisition, conversion and retention.
Expertise in using quantitative evidence—including experimentation and causal analysis—to inform decisions, while knowing when the most valuable contribution is defining the right problem or opportunity.
Strong technical analytical skills, including SQL, and the ability to guide reliable, high-quality analytics.
Excellent communication skills: you can make complex ideas clear, form a point of view and bring people with you.
The ability to set long-term direction while staying close enough to the work to help teams make progress.
An interest in international payments and the needs of people sending money across borders.

You’ll be a strategic partner to the Global Send Experience Squad, working closely with Product, Design and Engineering to understand the space, find opportunities and shape what the squad does next.
You’ll lead a team of senior analysts who work alongside their product teams on day-to-day questions and decisions. You’ll help them connect that work to the squad’s broader strategy, share insights across teams and keep the focus on the customer and business outcomes that matter most.

Sending money across borders is at the heart of Wise. By helping us understand what customers need and setting a clear direction for how we serve them, you’ll shape the choices that make Wise the best way to send money—at every stage of the customer journey.
You’ll help us grow our money transfer business while making it easier, faster and more affordable for customers around the world. For everyone, everywhere.

Localisation Experience: 2+ years of project or program management experience delivering cross-functional, end-to-end client-side localisation initiatives (in tech, fintech, or digital product environments).
Tooling & MT/AI Expertise: Solid hands-on experience using Translation Management Systems / CAT tools (e.g., Crowdin, Phrase, XTM, Smartling) and integrating MT/AI workflows with human review.
Stakeholder & Vendor Ops: Proven track record managing external vendors (LSPs, freelancers) and collaborating with cross-functional internal stakeholders (Product, Marketing, Engineering, Legal).
High-Pressure Execution: Ability to prioritize, flex, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment with competing deadlines, changing scopes, and varied content types (UI strings, emails, marketing copy, legal text).
Autonomy & Ambiguity: Comfortable working with minimal supervision, dealing with ambiguity, and influencing decisions through clear communication and trust-building.
Cultural Sensitivity: Deep appreciation of linguistic nuances, internationalisation requirements (variables, ICU plurals, RTL), and cultural sensitivities across markets.
Right to Work in Estonia: You are currently based in Estonia and hold a valid work permit.
Some Extra Hints That Would Be Great (Nice-to-Haves)
Experience managing localisation specifically for Product UI and Marketing content in a financial or tech company.
Experience with CRM integrations, Git, Figma connectors, or continuous localisation setups.
Industry certifications such as PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum.
Additional Information
What We Offer
Competitive Salary: €3,600 – €4,700 gross monthly (depending on your skills and experience)
Equity: New Hire Stock Grant.
Growth & Impact: High-impact role in a growing global team with opportunities to launch new languages, experiment with AI tools, and shape localisation operations.
Workplace Flexibility: Hybrid work setup from our Tallinn office
If you're ready to take on an exciting challenge and help shape our newly expanding accounting team, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your resume in English. We start reviewing applications as they come in, so we recommend applying as soon as possible! 💚

Application Review: We evaluate your background in localisation project or program management, focusing on client-side experience, handling product and marketing content, familiarity with CAT/TMS tools (such as Crowdin or Phrase), and MT/AI workflow implementation.
Screening Call with a Recruiter (30 mins): A brief conversation to discuss your background as a Localisation PM, daily tooling, translation/review/QA processes, vendor management experience and motivation to join Wise.
1st Stage Interview – PM Craft & Localisation Fundamentals (60 mins - in Google Meet): A conversation to surface your core fit, end-to-end localisation project management craft, tooling knowledge, vendor management, stakeholder expectation setting, and prioritisation under pressure.

ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II with deep systems thinking, data engineering expertise, and a product-oriented mindset to join our Treasury FX function — spanning both the Market Data and Risk Engineering teams.
Our team builds the real-time infrastructure that powers Wise's FX pricing, risk management, and trade execution. We aggregate market data from Bloomberg and Reuters, compute live exposure and VaR, execute hedges worth tens to hundreds of millions of pounds daily, and protect the business from adverse currency movements. Our systems are tier- 1 and serve 50+ internal consumers with sub-second freshness across 50+ currency pairs.
You will be the technical anchor across both engineering teams, owning the architectural direction of 14+ production services, from rate ingestion and distribution, through real-time risk calculation, to automated hedge execution. The primary mission: build Wise's first semi-automated trade and hedge execution platform in close coordination with FX dealers, quantitative researchers, and treasury controllers.
We operate on a strong belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We're looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Finance & Treasury tribe.
Our stack is polyglot and modern: Java 21 + Spring Boot 4.x, Python 3.12,  Apache Flink  (streaming), Kafka, gRPC + Protobuf, and Bloomberg/Reuters real-time feeds. This isn't typical CRUD — it's real-time financial infrastructure where a 1bps improvement in hedging efficiency saves millions.
We need a seasoned engineer who can architect streaming data pipelines, collaborate with quants on model productionisation, drive reliability across mission-critical systems, and translate complex business requirements from traders and risk managers into elegant technical solutions.
What will you be working on?
You will own the technical direction and architectural evolution of Wise's FX engineering stack, with immediate focus on:
Architecting a semi-automated hedge execution platform,  from exposure decomposition through model-driven hedge proposals to programmatic trade execution on external partners
Building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink for portfolio-split exposure computation, tenor interpolation, and hedge lifecycle event processing
Evolving our rate infrastructure for 10x throughput with FX Forwards, new corridors, NDFs and work on cross-provider deviation alerting
Building production infrastructure for quant models for VaR, beta-adjusted exposure management, dynamic pricing and FRP cancellations.
Owning Kafka topology design and schema evolution across the full pipeline: rate ingestion → risk calculation → trade execution → analytics
Driving technical roadmap across both teams, mentoring IC2/IC3 engineers, and leading incident response for Tier-1 critical services
Qualifications
We acknowledge that engineers continuously evolve their skillsets, and we are committed to supporting your growth. However, we are looking for candidates who can bring these core skills to the table:
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in financial systems, trading, or real-time data infrastructure
Deep expertise in Java (17+) with Spring Boot in high-throughput production environments
Extensive experience with Apache Kafka, topic design, schema evolution, consumer group management at scale
Strong data engineering skills, building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, or equivalent
Proven track record designing and operating distributed systems processing millions of events per day
Demonstrated ability to own system reliability end-to-end: SLOs, alerting, incident response, disaster recovery
Experience leading technical design of complex multi-service architectures and influencing without direct authority
Exceptional product mindset — able to translate business requirements from traders, operations, and quants into technical strategy
Track record of mentoring senior and junior engineers and raising team-wide engineering standards
The successful candidate will onboard as the technical anchor for both FX engineering teams, bringing architectural leadership and deep systems expertise while contributing to the transformative impact our platform has on Wise's FX operations.

ld.desc:
Company Description

Job Description
We are looking for a passionate Senior Data Engineer II to join our Treasury Global Liquidity team. In this role, you will help design and build the foundations of our real-time liquidity observability stack and core streaming data pipelines that power global financial operations at Wise.
You will be responsible for delivering key infrastructure initiatives, setting the technical streaming strategyand building robust, scalable systems that handle high-velocity financial movement with zero room for error. You will have a direct and measurable impact across multiple Wise products by enabling dynamic, real-time capital positioning as one of the founding engineers of a high-visibility team, laying the groundwork today and scaling the full engineering capability over the next year.
At Wise, we operate in autonomous, cross-functional teams. You will work in a highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Quantitative Analysts, and Treasury Ops.
Engineering at Wise is founded on clear communication, healthy debate to reach technical clarity, and a deep consciousness of system edge cases and failure modes before code hits production.
What will you be working on?
You will transform the financial engineering impact by pioneering our real-time Liquidity Attribution Model (LAM)! You will architect high-throughput Kafka and Flink streaming pipelines that continuously process global bank transactions, dynamically balancing demand against supply intraday. 
This is an opportunity to architect low-latency streaming pipelines that deliver instant, global liquidity visibility across every currency, jurisdiction, and nostro account. 
You'll build the high-octane engine behind our cash positioning, routing high-value transactions instantaneously with fine-grained event controls, fueling ML forecasting models to maximize yield on surplus capital, and bulletproofing our event architecture against out-of-order spikes, network partitions, and schema shifts.
You will also master a cutting-edge Medallion architecture and pairing streaming pipelines with sub-second OLAP querying, empowering Treasury Ops with instant, precise visibility into unencumbered liquidity redefining how global treasury operates at scale long before end-of-day.
The squad operates with high ownership and low ego, thriving on clear, actionable communication that bridges the gap between complex streaming architecture and real-world Treasury impact. 
Navigating high-stakes trade-offs across latency, financial cost, regulatory boundaries, and customer experience is second nature to us. This will give you the opportunity to proactively chase clarity using collaborative RFCs, whiteboard sessions, and direct stakeholder loops to solve ambiguity before it hits production. 
Above all, we lead by example: writing well-tested, maintainable code, rigorous design reviews, and constantly raising the engineering bar together.
Qualifications
We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more we do want to hear from you!
Advanced Stream Processing & Event-Driven Architecture: Proven track record building, deploying, and operating production-grade, low-latency stream processing pipelines using Apache Kafka (or Kafka Streams, Flink, Spark Streaming).
Idempotency & Event Reliability: Deep hands-on experience handling duplicate events, out-of-order log processing, late-arriving data, and exactly-once processing semantics in financial or mission-critical domains.
Real-Time Data Aggregation: Strong expertise in windowing techniques (tumbling, sliding, session windows), stateful stream processing, and high-throughput real-time aggregation across streaming data pipelines.
Streaming Data Modeling: Advanced experience in modeling data for both real-time stream consumer patterns and downstream analytical stores (e.g., event schemas, state store schemas, schema evolution with Protobuf/Avro).
Defensive Engineering & Failure Modes: You will instinctively design for dead-letter queues, backpressure management, circuit breakers, and state-store recovery.

ld.desc:
Company Description

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
About the team:
We're a small team that ships freuently and iterates on real partner feedback. Engineers own features from technical discovery and design through to production support. We work closely with our PM and designer to understand partner needs, and with adjacent teams (API Experience, Account Discovery, KYC, FinCrime) to pull their capabilities into the portal.
We investigate before we build. That means managing ambiguity, understanding the existing systems, APIs and dependencies before writing code. We keep process light: quick standups, focused 1:1s, and quarterly planning.
Job Description
Wise helps banks, software companies, and large enterprises use Wise's infrastructure to offer their customers cross-border payment products through our API. We're a cross-functional team across sales, implementation, product, engineering, compliance, and analytics, based in New York, London, and Singapore.
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer II to join our Partner Experience team in London.
The Partner Experience team builds and runs the systems that let enterprise partners go live faster and manage their day-to-day operations in one place. 
We own the Partner Portal (used by many big banks to manage transfers, report fraud, handle compliance requests, and manage their teams) and the backend services behind partner onboarding, permissions, and communication. Most of what we build is new. There's no existing playbook for enterprise partner tooling at this scale, so you'll be designing systems from scratch more often than maintaining existing ones.
What will you be working on?:
• Backend microservices for partner-facing features: fraud reporting, case management, RFI handling, audit logging, and transaction visibility.
• The permissions and role-based access control system that governs what partners can do in the portal.
• SSO (SAML 2.0) integration for enterprise partners, including solving identity mapping between partner systems and Wise.
• The communication layer services between Wise and partners, extending them to handle new case types and workflows.
• API design for partner-facing endpoints. We care about consistency, documentation, and making them usable without hand-holding.
• Work with FinCrime, Compliance, and KYC teams to bring sanctions RFI workflows and fraud reporting into the portal.
• Technical discovery: mapping existing systems, evaluating dependencies, producing design documents that become the team's source of truth.
• Production support and debugging when live partner issues come up.
Qualifications
What do you need:
• Experience designing, building, and deploying backend microservices in Java and Spring Boot.
• Familiarity with domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, and microservices patterns. You think in terms of domain boundaries, aggregates, and service responsibilities.
• Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs commercially. Comfort with OpenAPI/Swagger, OAuth2, and versioning strategies.
• Ability to design and maintain relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), including query performance, indexing, and data modelling.
• You enjoy mapping complex technical landscapes: understanding existing systems, dependencies, and constraints before proposing solutions. You write clear documentation of what you find.
• You deliver reliably and manage your own work without needing constant check-ins
• You work well with adjacent teams, unblock yourself when dependencies come up, and build relationships that go beyond PR reviews.
• You understand what large enterprise customers need from software: reliability, auditability, compliance, and security as design constraints, not bolt-ons.
Nice to have:
• Experience building enterprise portals, partner platforms, or B2B SaaS products.
• Understanding of payments systems and the complexities of cross-border money movement.
• Experience with identity and access management (SAML, SSO, SPIFFE, OAuth2).
• Familiarity with Kafka or other event streaming platforms.
• Experience in a platform team serving multiple internal or external consumers.
• Ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical people (product managers, partners, compliance teams).
• Interest in international finance, foreign exchange, or payments infrastructure.

ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
